title: fix(deps): move zod to ^4.6.6 and clear the lockfile's high and critical advisories
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWGGKysRudWM9W6GPewxH8S)_
Fixes #25631
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Every manifest that declares `zod` now asks for `^4.6.6`, past GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, and the workspace resolves one zod, 4.6.7. Every other advisory `pnpm audit` matched on `main` moves to its patched release, except `@azure/msal-node`, which has no upstream path yet (below).

## `pnpm audit`, before and after

Measured with pnpm 10.31.0 against the lockfile, `main` at `49653f9` vs this branch.

| | critical | high | moderate | low |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `pnpm audit --prod`, main | 5 | 10 | 8 | 3 |
| `pnpm audit` (all), main | 5 | 11 | 10 | 3 |
| `pnpm audit` (all), this branch | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 |

## What moved

| Package | Was | Now | Advisories | How |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| zod | 4.6.1, 4.6.5 | 4.6.7 (one copy) | GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (high) | `^4.6.6` in the 12 manifests that declared `^4.6.5` and in apps/docs (`^4.6.1`) |
| next | 16.3.8 | 16.4.1 | GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr (critical), GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r (high) | apps/docs exact pin moved; better-auth's optional `next` peer followed it |
| dompurify | 3.4.16 | 3.4.17 | GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7 (critical), GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr (high), 1 low | override target `^3.4.17` (mermaid `^3.3.3` admits it) |
| body-parser | 2.3.0 | 2.4.0 | GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 (high) | new override over the 2.x major → `^2.4.0` (express 5.2.1 `^2.2.1` admits it) |
| happy-dom | 20.10.2 | not installed | GHSA-834v-8h66-3h79 (high) | new override from the advisory's 17.0.0 floor up to the 22.0.0 major boundary → `^21.0.4`; see Acceptance notes |
| postal-mime | 4.0.5 | 4.1.4 | GHSA-f2hq-32vh-53cc (high) | service-mailbox `^4.0.5` → `^4.0.8` |
| undici | 7.30.0, 8.11.2 | 7.30.1, 8.12.3 | GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c (high), 2 moderate, on both lines | override targets `^7.30.1` and `^8.12.2`, selectors unchanged |
| nodemailer | 10.0.13 | 10.2.1 | 3 moderate | plugin-email `^10.0.2` → `^10.1.4` |
| fast-uri | 3.1.8 | 3.1.9 | 2 moderate, 2 low | override target `^3.1.9` |
| ip-address | 10.7.2 | 10.7.4 | 1 moderate | override target `^10.7.4` |

The lockfile is regenerated by `pnpm install`, never edited by hand. The resolved package set changes only in the rows above, the `@next/*` binaries that move with next, and happy-dom with its four private dependencies leaving. Each new or moved override carries its reason in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, in the block dated 2026-10-24.

## Not cleared: `@azure/msal-node` GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 (high)

5.4.1 comes from `@azure/identity` 4.13.1 (`^5.1.0`) under tedious 18.6.2, driver-sql's optional mssql peer. The fix is only in msal-node 7.1.0. No `@azure/identity` release admits it: 4.14.0 (latest) and 4.15.0-beta.1 both declare `^6.0.0`. Clearing it here would mean forcing two majors past identity's declared range on an Azure AD sign-in path that no test in this workspace runs, so it is reported as a finding and not pinned. This PR does not make it worse: the OSV verdict on a pull request is base-relative, and `main` already carries it.

## Generated surfaces

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts are up to date under zod 4.6.7 (JSON schemas, API surface, export origins, declaration map, docs). Nothing was regenerated, so there is nothing to commit.

The vendored Console keeps one zod: objectui at the pinned `2958f17e9c6a` already resolves zod 4.6.7, which satisfies the spec's new `^4.6.6` range.

## Verification

Local, at head `5396e799bb`:

- `pnpm build`: 76 of 76 tasks.
- Workspace typecheck (`turbo run typecheck`, 4096 MB heap, the runner's V8 default): 152 of 152 tasks. Under this container's 2096 MB default, `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`'s `tsc --noEmit` runs out of heap. That is not this change: the same program reports 4,167,189K memory used on `main`'s dependency set and 4,166,613K on this branch (`tsc --extendedDiagnostics`).
- Tests, every package whose manifest moved: spec 21725, core 2757, objectql 8700, runtime 7035, metadata 905, metadata-core 796, metadata-protocol 21474, rest 6400, mcp 533, driver-turso 2492, plugin-email 689, service-mailbox 152, lint 7244, cli `--project unit` 4816 tests. All pass.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 101 derived families run, 101 exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (0 unrun, 0 not measured). Two needed full history first: `check-engine-split-ratio` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` refuse a shallow clone.
- `pnpm check:override-consistency`, `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract-resolve`, `node scripts/check-osv-exemptions.mjs`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

CI on the same head: all 44 check runs are success or skipped, including Validate Package Dependencies (OSV base-relative), Build Docs (next 16.4.1), Build Core, Test Core 1 to 6, TypeScript Type Check and Lint & Repo Gates. Console Pin Gate runs neither on a pull request nor in the merge queue (its `if:` excludes both), so its first verdict comes after landing; the pinned objectui resolves zod 4.6.7, inside the spec's new `^4.6.6`, which is the range its build asserts against.

## Acceptance notes

- **`@azure/msal-node`** stays, for the reason above. It needs either an `@azure/identity` release that accepts msal-node 7.1.0 or a maintainer decision to force it.
- **happy-dom no longer resolves at all.** It was only vitest's optional `happy-dom: *` peer, auto-installed; no manifest declares it and no vitest config selects that environment. With the peer rewritten to `^21.0.4`, pnpm does not install it. `check:override-consistency` lists the entry as having 0 consumers, which is a report, not a failure; the entry stays as the floor a future declaration lands on.
- **The moderate and low advisories ride along.** The card asks for high and critical. The rest are target lifts in the same file and two declared ranges, and `main`'s scheduled OSV scan fails on every severity.
- **Serial constraint:** #25639 edits the cli, hono and plugin-dev manifests and may move `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Whichever lands second regenerates the lockfile with pnpm.
